description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named InsertingCells that manages a list view with animated insertion of new list items, including image animations and layout updates.

classes.name: InsertingCells
classes.description: Main activity that manages a list view with animated row insertions, including handling button clicks for adding rows and managing animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list view, button, and data items, and configures the animation listener.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Handles the button click to add a new row to the list, optionally with animation if supported.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationStart
methods.description: Disables the add button at the start of the row addition animation.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationEnd
methods.description: Re-enables the add button after the row addition animation completes.
